notes: v1.1.103: 2FA codes always use the TRUE time (NTP, else Facebook/Google HTTPS time) - a PC/RDP with a wrong clock or blocked NTP no longer sends wrong 2FA codes; a warning shows if no true time is reachable; a rejected code refetches the time. Captcha: Google puzzle loops stop after 5 unticked rounds (flagged IP) instead of burning 150 s; OMOCaptcha maintenance is not retried on phones. More human: Page-system Follow opens the profile and presses Follow (no API call), no instant page jumps before Page-system clicks, a paused video is restarted with a tap on its Play button, and a video Facebook auto-advances is gone back to. Show-Case: all 6 services (Reaction, Comment, Page Review, Follower, Group Member, Video Watch Time) in every system - Browser (m + web), Page system (acting AS the page), ADB (new Review Page task); website orders run on all three. m-mode reactions pick the right reaction; Page comments no longer double-post; website ADB orders check the account proxy first.
